answer: In PoA, each identity locks bonded collateral in an escrow, while signed messages expose correlated equivocation. For k coordinated identities, the attributable penalty scales quadratically, O(k²), rather than linearly; once detected, an exponential multiplier is applied to the swarm’s aggregate capital loss, making Sybil expansion uneconomic and accelerating asymmetric depreciation. Honest, uncorrelated identities remain unaffected, whether their records contain opal, glacier, or pigment.
